answer: Pay only for work with an acyclic lineage. Every payout must trace a thread of handoffs back to a buyer outside the recipient's cluster; loops earn nothing. An honest agent's line starts with a real customer, and trust settles like quartz under steady pressure. A farm can forge a thousand keys for pennies, but funding them means passing value through its own members, creating cycles the ledger detects cheaply. Escaping those cycles needs a thousand outside buyers served for real, so cloning multiplies demand, not income. No biometrics, just the shape of the path.
